links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT-3.5 responses to diabetic foot ulcer questions
links.effect: ChatGPT-3.5 answered at a mean grade level of 11.9±1.8, nearly 4 grade levels higher than the American average.
links.quote: ChatGPT-3.5 answered at the mean grade level of 11.9±1.8.

links.outcome: Readability of AI patient-facing responses relative to patient comprehension
links.effect: Mean grade level 11.9±1.8, nearly 4 grade levels above the American average; reviewers nonetheless praised simplicity (n=11/11).
links.quote: ChatGPT-3.5 answered at the mean grade level of 11.9±1.8.

links.outcome: Incorrect or incomplete information in ChatGPT-3.5 responses, as rated by plastic surgeons
links.effect: Three responses presented incorrect information; 10/11 omitted key information such as DVT symptoms and comorbid conditions affecting limb salvage. Mean accuracy 8.7±0.3, danger 2.2±0.6.
links.quote: Three responses presented incorrect information, and the majority of responses (n=10/11) left out key information, such as deep vein thrombosis symptoms and comorbid conditions impacting limb salvage.

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance, accuracy, danger, and readability of ChatGPT-3.5 in answering patient-oriented diabetic foot ulcer questions without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or guardrail.
